summary: Bonner County cabin with a roof platform, dated 1921 by two pages (1910-1914 by a third); removed on an unknown date. The site has rock dugouts and debris; a hiking trail reaches it.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed; no source gives the date.

access.note: Hike-in on a trail the Idaho Fire Lookouts page calls fairly popular.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in; the site has rock dugouts and scattered debris, per the authors' 2026 visit.

events.note: Built sometime between 1910 and 1914, per a museum source quoted on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page; the same source says it is on the 1914 maps
Telephone communications established to Trestle creek lookout, per an April 17, 1914 Pend Oreille Review item quoted by the Forest Lookouts page
Fires on Lightning Creek reported to the local forestry office by the lookout, August 20, 1915 (Fruitland Banner item quoted by the Forest Lookouts page)
Tom D. Burleigh, aged 22, staffed the lookout
Several fires reported on Burleigh's first day, July 1917
Shingled cabin with a roof platform constructed
Staffed by Stidwell, per a 1921 entry citing Fire Lookouts of the Northwest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Idaho Fire Lookouts page gives 1910 to 1914 for the first lookout, based on museum records and the 1914 maps. Two other pages date a cabin with a roof platform to 1921. The 1914 telephone item points to a lookout before 1921. The sources do not settle the first build date, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Elevation differs (6032 ft on firelookout.com, 6320 ft on Idaho Fire Lookouts); not stored in facts. A Facebook post from search says the lookout was built in 1921; not read, not cited. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page dates its 2026 visit and says a fire has since changed the site, with no date for the fire. No new photos recorded; the page images had no URLs in the cached text.
